items.t: Wedbush Maintains Outperform on Corsair Gaming, Raises Price Target to $17
items.sum: Wedbush analyst Alicia Reese maintains Corsair Gaming (NASDAQ:CRSR) with a Outperform and raises the price target from $16 to $17.

items.t: Red Cat Downbeat Q3 Results, Joins Omeros, Deutsche Bank And Other Big Stocks Moving Lower In Tuesday’s Pre-Market Session
items.sum: U.S. stock futures fell as Red Cat plunged 25.8% after weak Q3 results and withdrawing FY26 guidance; several stocks also declined premarket.
